prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.6% average after noise correction), winning 2 of 3 tests while 1 test showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.1% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen, sign_in redesign, and adoption redesign changes, as only 1 test has been completed for each kind.
Predictions have generally been too high, though round 7 was underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -7.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Full bleed story screen intro redesign: Redesign the story intro screen with a full bleed layout and playful pet mascot to boost initial engagement. (why: choose_path step drops 23.8% of users with a high mean completion time of 514s.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive welcome splash screen: Add a new welcome splash screen before story to set expectations and introduce pet choices. (why: Initial onboarding drop-off at choose_path is 23.8%, indicating a need for a clearer app intro.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Choose path screen helper hint: Display a clear hint on the choose path screen explaining the difference between premade and custom pets. (why: Mean time for choose_path is 514s compared to median 8s, suggesting confusion for some users during path selection.)
3: [sign_in, notification] Sign-in progress indicator and notification toggle: Enable progress bar and background notification toggle on the sign-in screen. (why: Support received 2 emails reporting sign-in stalling and 8 emails about account sync confusion.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Carousel layout redesign for pick friend screen: Redesign the pick friend screen into a dynamic carousel layout with enlarged live pet previews. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and median time of 89s.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Guided custom pet photo upload flow: Upgrade photo upload screen with a photo picker tool and tip carousel to ensure high photo quality. (why: Support logged 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.)
6: [adoption, copy] Adoption certificate confirmation button copy update: Update adoption certificate screen headline and action button label for clearer step progression. (why: Over 39% of users drop off during the adoption flow before reaching waiting screen.)
7: [home, wait_info] Generation timer and progress display on waiting screen: Add an estimated time display, progress bar, and automatic tip delay to the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing user uncertainty.)
8: [home, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for desktop waiting screen: Redesign waiting screen with a spotlight layout featuring an animated pet status indicator. (why: 3 support mails report pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open during desktop prep.)
9: [finish, copy] Home intro desktop controls copy update: Update home intro copy with clear desktop interaction instructions and tray icon hints. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support received 3 emails about unclear controls/hiding/talking to pet.)

scores.note: Redesigns have shown negative average lift in tests and lack support email evidence.
